reasons: Rule is a direction rule that is satisfied by the absence of an MFN obligation on Customer; the cited pricing paragraphs (Exhibit B license fees and revenue-share) contain only fixed amounts and percentages, with no undertaking by Corio to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers.

Rationale documents a reasonable search across the plausible homes for MFN/best-pricing language (Section 4 Fees, Exhibit B pricing/payment, Exhibit D cooperation) and the search terms used, supporting the preferred-position conclusion.

Consistent with the claimed compliant status, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, and the rendered text is unchanged — appropriate treatment as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
No deterministic check failures; no indication of a Vendor-granted MFN in Customer's favour being incorrectly flagged or deleted.
